description: One semantic classification per public refusal emission observed at the boundaries named in WK-2359's write_scope. Each entry is assigned EXACTLY ONE DEC-0177 mechanical limb (or exact_returned_policy), names the operation that would have failed, and states what continuing would have done unsafely. Procedure-only rules are excluded: under DEC-0177 a rule about what SHOULD happen is policy, not a mechanical refusal, and does not belong in this taxonomy.

provenance.worktree_state: the pinned commit plus WK-2359's own uncommitted changes to its write_scope; the corpus describes the population as WK-2359 leaves it
provenance.audit_method: Static enumeration of registered runtime-blocker code identities referenced by the production (.mjs, non-test) source files named in WK-2359's write_scope, resolved through RUNTIME_BLOCKER_CODES / DISPATCH_BLOCKER_CODES / DISPATCH_MECHANICAL_BLOCKER_CODES enum access and bare string literals, then matched against packages/wiki-core/data/runtime-blocker-codes.v1.json.
provenance.declared_population: public refusal emissions at WK-2359's in-scope boundaries ONLY
